scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Almost-everywhere regularity of stationary integral varifolds” (preprints/Almost-everywhere-regularity-of-stationary-integral-varifolds-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 346 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f12bd8f9ace9a350), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Every stationary integral m-varifold in an open subset of Rm+n satisfies Hm (Sing V ) = 0. Here m, n ≥ 1 are arbitrary. No stability, minimizing, orientability, density upper bound, or codimension-one hypothesis is required.
